title: Post-Mutation Reservation Acceptance Composition
classification: pure synchronous post-authoritative-mutation acceptance-evidence composition boundary
decomposition: FOOD-007W owns only the post-FOOD-007V construction of existing FOOD-005L reservation-acceptance evidence after an authoritative durable reservation result has already been obtained. It does not own reservation mutation, governing-source policy, commitment-scope policy, capacity arithmetic, capacity admission, capacity-source reads, acceptance persistence, payment, fulfillment, release or physical inventory movement.
purpose: Correlate one canonical FOOD-007N reservation hold command, one FOOD-007V authoritative mutation result and the exact physical-order snapshot required by FOOD-005L. Only a FOOD-007V created or already-present result may produce FOOD-005L acceptance evidence. The accepted composition retains both the authoritative reservation receipt and the FOOD-005L acceptance value so reservation provenance is not discarded.

dependencies.food007n: Canonical reservation hold command and reservation identity.
dependencies.food007v: Authoritative durable reservation mutation result and successful mutation receipt.
dependencies.food005l: Existing pure reservation-acceptance evidence domain and initial acceptance constructor.

publicApi.signature: deriveFoodPostMutationReservationAcceptance(command: FoodReservationHoldCommand, mutationResult: FoodAuthoritativeCapacityReservationMutationResult, order: FoodPhysicalOrderVersion, identityInput: unknown, acceptanceInput: unknown): FoodPostMutationReservationAcceptanceResult

acceptedComposition.reservation: The exact FOOD-007V FoodAuthoritativeCapacityReservationMutationReceipt associated with the supplied command.
acceptedComposition.acceptance: The exact FOOD-005L FoodReservationAcceptanceVersion constructed only after successful mutation-result correlation.

accepted.meaning: The supplied FOOD-007V result is created or already-present, its success receipt exactly correlates with the canonical FOOD-007N command, the supplied physical-order snapshot exactly correlates with the command request and fulfillment snapshots, and FOOD-005L acceptance construction succeeds.

reservation-not-established.meaning: FOOD-007V did not establish an authoritative durable reservation outcome that is permitted to produce reservation acceptance. FOOD-007W creates no FOOD-005L acceptance.

invalid.meaning: The command, mutation result, success receipt, physical order, acceptance identity/metadata or their required correlations are malformed or inconsistent, or the supplied FOOD-007V outcome is invalid. FOOD-007W creates no returned acceptance.

sequence: Capture and structurally validate caller-controlled inputs without invoking accessors or caller hooks.
Correlate command.order exactly to the supplied physical-order identity and version.
For governing-source-mismatch, insufficient-capacity, conflict or storage-failure, return reservation-not-established with the exact reservation outcome and construct no FOOD-005L acceptance.
For FOOD-007V invalid, return invalid and construct no FOOD-005L acceptance.
For FOOD-007V created or already-present, validate the success receipt and correlate it exactly to the command before acceptance construction.
Validate that the supplied order, command selection reservation request and command selection fulfillment intent satisfy existing FOOD-005L source-binding requirements.

Invoke existing FOOD-005L createInitialFoodReservationAcceptanceVersion using the caller-supplied acceptance identity/version, exact physical-order snapshot, exact command reservation-request snapshot, exact command fulfillment-intent snapshot and caller-supplied acceptance metadata.
Return one deeply frozen accepted composition retaining both the FOOD-007V receipt and the FOOD-005L acceptance.

mutationResultGate.created: Acceptance construction is permitted after exact success-receipt correlation.
mutationResultGate.already-present: Acceptance construction is permitted after exact replay-receipt correlation because FOOD-007V has proven the same canonical durable reservation already exists and performs no new write.
mutationResultGate.storage-failure: No acceptance because authoritative durable reservation success is uncertain.

receiptCorrelation.reservationIdentity: The FOOD-007V receipt reservation identity must equal command.reservationId exactly.
receiptCorrelation.order: Receipt order identity/version must equal command.order exactly.
receiptCorrelation.reservationRequest: Receipt reservation-request identity/version must equal command.selection.request exactly.
receiptCorrelation.fulfillmentIntent: Receipt fulfillment identity/version and method/location/window must equal command.selection.fulfillmentIntent exactly.
receiptCorrelation.skuClaims: Receipt SKU claims must exactly equal the command selected SKU identities, selected revisions and canonical demand quantities in canonical request order.
receiptCorrelation.slotClaim: Receipt slot identity, selected revision and quantity-one semantics must exactly equal the command slot selection.

orderCorrelation.identity: Supplied physical-order id/version must equal command.order id/version exactly.
orderCorrelation.reservationRequest: The physical-order reservation-request binding must equal command.selection.request identity/version exactly.
orderCorrelation.fulfillmentIntent: The physical-order fulfillment-intent binding/snapshot must equal command.selection.fulfillmentIntent exactly.
orderCorrelation.capacityRequirements: FOOD-005L must validate that acceptance capacity requirements exactly equal the canonical reservation-request requirements. FOOD-007W does not invent, reorder, aggregate or alter demand.

food005lConstruction.identity: Caller supplied. FOOD-007W does not derive a FOOD-005L acceptance identity from the capacity reservation identity.
food005lConstruction.clock: FOOD-007W does not read the current clock or invent acceptedOn.

capacitySourceBoundary.reason: FOOD-007V already established authoritative durable reservation success inside its protected mutation boundary. FOOD-005L acceptance evidence does not contain SKU or slot capacity-source revisions. Re-reading capacity after mutation would create a different-time observation and is neither required nor permitted as an acceptance prerequisite.

provenanceBoundary.safeClaim: Within a FOOD-007W accepted composition, the retained FOOD-007V receipt is the authoritative durable-reservation evidence and the retained FOOD-005L value is the corresponding immutable reservation-acceptance evidence.
provenanceBoundary.detachedFood005lLimitation: A FOOD-005L acceptance value used alone does not structurally encode the FOOD-007V reservation identity or selected capacity-source revisions. FOOD-007W does not silently add those fields to FOOD-005L.

trustBoundary.structuralValidation: FOOD-007W validates shapes and exact correlations.
trustBoundary.callerProvenance: A structurally valid caller-supplied object does not by itself authenticate that a mutation result actually came from FOOD-007V.
trustBoundary.trustedCompositionRequirement: Operational callers must pass the actual FOOD-007V result produced by the trusted reservation service path; FOOD-007W does not authenticate arbitrary caller provenance, database provenance or service identity.
trustBoundary.cachedCapacityEvidence: No pre-V cached policy/arithmetic/admission artifact is accepted as a substitute for FOOD-007V success.

replayBoundary.food007vAlreadyPresent: An exact FOOD-007V already-present result is sufficient reservation-success evidence for acceptance construction after exact correlation.
replayBoundary.meaning: FOOD-007W is pure construction. Repeating the same valid inputs may reproduce equivalent immutable acceptance evidence but does not prove or persist a globally unique acceptance record.

failureAtomicityBoundary.meaning: FOOD-007W cannot roll back or alter a durable FOOD-007V reservation because it performs no reservation mutation. A later acceptance-persistence unit, if introduced, must define its own idempotency and failure semantics.

acceptanceAuthority.meaning: FOOD-007W is the first FOOD-007-series unit permitted to construct FOOD-005L reservation-acceptance evidence, and only after FOOD-007V authoritative reservation success.

safeClaim: If FOOD-007W returns accepted, the supplied canonical FOOD-007N command and exact physical-order snapshot were structurally correlated to a FOOD-007V created or already-present authoritative reservation result, and the returned FOOD-005L acceptance evidence was constructed only after that successful reservation-result gate. The retained receipt preserves authoritative reservation provenance for the composition.
sideEffects: None. FOOD-007W is planned as a pure synchronous server-library composition over existing canonical values and FOOD-005L construction. No SQL, database access, filesystem access, network access, environment access, current clock, randomness, generated IDs, routes, deployment or production mutation.
validationPlan: Specification parses as JSON and locks FOOD-007W identity, starting HEAD and prospective artifact paths.
Focused implementation tests must prove acceptance only for FOOD-007V created and already-present success results.
Every FOOD-007V failure outcome must prove zero FOOD-005L acceptance construction.
Success receipt must be exactly correlated to command reservation identity, order, request, fulfillment, every SKU claim and the slot claim.
Canonical SKU order must be preserved and mismatched, reordered or duplicate claims must be invalid rather than repaired.
Supplied physical order must correlate exactly to command.order and the request/fulfillment snapshots consumed by FOOD-005L.
FOOD-005L identity and acceptance metadata validation must remain delegated to existing canonical FOOD-005L behavior rather than redefined inconsistently.
Accepted result must retain both the FOOD-007V receipt and FOOD-005L acceptance.
Output must be deeply frozen and detached.
Hostile accessors, symbols, sparse arrays, extended arrays, custom prototypes and cyclic shapes must fail closed with zero accessor invocation.
Source must contain no database, SQL, migration, clock, randomness, payment-provider, route or production dependencies.
Critical reservation chain and full FOOD regression suites must remain green.
Astro must report zero FOOD-007W and zero src/lib/food TypeScript diagnostics; existing unrelated global baseline debt may remain separately reported.
